resources.string: Use matching YouTube thumbnails as a fallback
When music sites have no suitable artwork, compare the video title, artist and duration. Live, cover and remix editions are kept separate.

Playback could not be separated reliably; showing the microphone reading.
Playback samples are compared with the microphone to estimate and remove playback leakage. This is a relative estimate, not a calibrated sound pressure measurement. Audio stays in memory.
